visual.name: orgPulse
visual.description: Animated org chart for any hierarchy with history: constellation and org chart layouts, a time player, open roles, and who moved where.

dataRoles.name: position
dataRoles.description: The seat each row describes (or the person, if you have no positions). Required.

dataRoles.name: reportsTo
dataRoles.description: The seat (or person) this one reports to. Blank for the top of the org.

dataRoles.name: person
dataRoles.description: Who sits in the seat. Blank means an open role.

dataRoles.name: name
dataRoles.description: Person name shown on nodes and cards

dataRoles.name: validFrom
dataRoles.description: First day this row applies. Leave empty for a static org chart.

dataRoles.name: validTo
dataRoles.description: Last day this row applies. Blank means it still applies.

dataRoles.name: group
dataRoles.description: Region, function or department: sets the colour

dataRoles.name: title
dataRoles.description: Job title shown under the name

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Filled, Open or On leave (optional: inferred from Person ID)

dataRoles.name: reason
dataRoles.description: Why the row starts: Hire, Transfer, Promotion, Reorg... (optional: inferred)

dataRoles.name: cost
dataRoles.description: Optional: annual cost of the person in the seat

dataRoles.name: targetSpan
dataRoles.description: Optional: most direct reports this seat should have

dataRoles.name: asOfPage
dataRoles.description: Optional: a measure returning the date the rest of the page is showing, e.g. MAX('As Of'[As Of Date])
